name: SPOT passive GMRES activity bounded run and publication

amendment.failure_point: fresh OFF normalized full-log comparison; cmp first reported character 9668 on line 126

scientific_question: Does the frozen STATIONARY one-map MCCG path contain at least one physical group and correction block with KMAX greater than zero?

clean_build.construction: clean parent Git archive plus the frozen validation-only overlay
clean_build.compile_and_link_flags_from_makefile: -O2 -march=native -ffp-contract=off -g; Darwin arm64 PIC defaults; OpenMP off
clean_build.toolchain_resolution: the frozen paths are the actual Command Line Tools executables, not the common /usr/bin xcrun launcher shim; final library and executable hashes in the run reference remain authoritative
required_before_RUN: the clean patched source census and every source hash pass
the linked Dragon executable is a regular non-symlink executable
the executable and linked-library SHA256 values plus required SPOMGMR symbols and nm/otool receipts are frozen in the committed run reference
the executable and complete run implementation manifest are rechecked before the first process and after the last process
all run implementation files are tracked and byte-identical to HEAD

immutable_inputs.copy_policy: each process receives distinct regular non-symlink copies of every common input and one PRE-initialized writable result.xsm, all with distinct inodes
immutable_inputs.immutability_check: common inputs and read-only references are unchanged before and after every process; result.xsm must equal PRE before execution and is the only permitted writable XSM during that process

activation.value_1: RUN only after every required committed implementation and executable gate passes
activation.stage_b_execution_authority: only the committed, tracked, byte-exact complete run implementation freeze plus explicit RUN_GMRES_ACTIVITY=1; the protocol freeze alone is insufficient

process_execution.executable: one frozen absolute non-overridable Dragon path created by the clean build
process_execution.stdin: the exact rendered regular non-symlink deck for that case
process_execution.stdout_and_stderr: one merged run.log created with exclusive-create semantics

execution_budget.timeout_role: operational process bound only; never a scientific acceptance threshold
execution_budget.termination_scope: only the exact spawned process group; never killall
execution_budget.outer_signal_result: terminate the exact spawned process group, then INVALID-NO-SCIENTIFIC-RESULT

common_runtime_records.grammar: the numeric CPU TIME field in the existing internal and external convergence receipts

common_runtime_records.ordering: after the unique FLU module end and before the unique capture COMPLETE execution marker
common_runtime_records.grammar: exact module name, spacing and labels; nonnegative F13.3 time field of width 13; nonnegative 1P,E10.3 memory field of width 10

common_runtime_records.ordering: after the unique capture COMPLETE execution marker and before normal Dragon termination
common_runtime_records.grammar: exact 'cle2000_c: cpu time= ' prefix, nonnegative fixed-two-decimal numeric field and exact ' second' suffix

ON_only_fixed_width_control_edits: one source-line ' MOCA 2 GMRA ;' to ' MOCA 2 ;     ' replacement
one execution-echo ' MOCA 2 GMRA ;' to ' MOCA 2 ;     ' replacement

reproducibility_and_closure: fresh OFF output is byte-identical to LEGACY_OFF_XSM
each ON output is identical to LEGACY_ON_XSM in every record outside the single added SPOT-GMR-AUD directory
each ON retains the existing SPOT-MOC-AUD directory unchanged

each normalized full log removes exactly two FLU2DR CPU fields, one KDRDRV FLU time/memory receipt and one top-level CLE-2000 CPU field; each ON additionally removes exactly the two declared fixed-width GMRA tokens
fresh OFF normalized full log is byte-identical to normalized LEGACY_OFF_LOG and each ON normalized full log is byte-identical to normalized LEGACY_ON_LOG
ON-A and ON-B output XSM files are byte-identical
ON-A and ON-B normalized logs are byte-identical
the independent Ganlib-only reader produces byte-identical complete raw ledgers for ON-A and ON-B and on a second read of each output
the reader independently closes every event, active mask, block, KMAX, histogram, aggregate and exact classification identity
all immutable inputs, executable bytes, source manifests and implementation manifests are unchanged after the three processes

independence.ledger_reader: independent read-only Ganlib-only executable built from check_gmres_activity_xsm.f90
independence.non_audit_comparator: a separate read-only Ganlib-only comparator that recursively checks all XSM records except SPOT-GMR-AUD
independence.log_checker: independent text parser with no Ganlib or solver import
independence.artifact_checker: independent Python parser that does not execute Dragon, import the writer, import the Fortran reader, or execute the production runner
independence.artifact_checker_scientific_reconstructi: only the raw ROLE, ROLE-ACTIVE, BLOCK and BLOCK-GROUP rows in the two independently read ledgers
independence.artifact_checker_validity_inputs: the complete required payload, including hashes, receipts, original and normalized logs, XSM identity evidence, reader replays and publication manifests
independence.artifact_checker_reconstruction: reconstruct every per-block per-group KMAX from raw Krylov active masks, compare it with raw BLOCK-GROUP KMAX, then derive the histogram, nonzero count, sum, maximum and classification
independence.invalid_artifact_checker_behavior: nonzero exit; create neither result.txt nor a final artifact

classification.INVALID: any identity, hash, process, log, XSM, ledger, reproducibility, publication or receipt check fails
classification.VALID-GMRES-UPDATE-INACTIVE: all checks pass and the exact nonzero-K group-block count is zero
classification.VALID-GMRES-UPDATE-ACTIVE: all checks pass and the exact nonzero-K group-block count is a positive integer

artifact.publication_lock: exclusive sibling mkdir acquired before the first Dragon process and released only after final artifact verification
artifact.staging: a fresh sibling directory on the same filesystem
artifact.publication: single atomic rename only after every check passes
artifact.publication_sequence: verify WORK payload, copy to same-filesystem PUBLISH, verify PUBLISH completely, atomically rename once, then verify the final artifact completely
artifact.case_directory_census: exact declared common inputs, PRE-initialized result, deck, exclusive run log and case-local tmp only; reject every undeclared path or type
run_receipt_tsv_rows_in_order: run_protocol_sha256	<SHA256 of frozen run protocol bytes>
run_implementation_manifest_sha256	<SHA256 of frozen run implementation manifest bytes>
executable_sha256	<SHA256 of the frozen linked Dragon>
artifact.scientific_decision_field: only CLASSIFICATION answers the frozen scientific question; histogram, nonzero count, sum and maximum are exact closure evidence
artifact.manifest_rule: sorted SHA256 rows for every regular payload except artifact_manifest.sha256 itself
artifact.post_publish_check: reopen the final path and independently verify its exact census, hashes, ledgers and result

required_artifact_checker_tests: tampered derived summary with unchanged raw rows is rejected rather than changing classification
tampered raw active mask is rejected
tampered raw BLOCK-GROUP KMAX is rejected
missing, duplicate, malformed, reordered or forged runtime telemetry is rejected
missing log, XSM identity, receipt or manifest evidence is rejected
invalid input creates neither result.txt nor a final artifact
run_implementation_freeze.before_execution: all required files, the linked executable SHA256 and its exact source construction are covered by the committed run implementation freeze and pass synthetic tests
run_implementation_freeze.state_at_protocol_freeze: AMENDED; RUN_GMRES_ACTIVITY=1 REMAINS UNAUTHORIZED UNTIL A NEW VERSION-2 RUN IMPLEMENTATION FREEZE

failure_and_retention.failed_work_directory: deleted unless an explicit diagnostic-only keep flag was set before execution

interpretation_limits: KMAX is an iteration-activity count, not a residual, error, convergence tolerance or model coefficient.
A positive K proves only that the existing GMRES correction path executed.
Zero K does not mean that the primary MOC evaluation was unused.
Neither valid class explains prior nontermination or attributes it to binary32, GMRES, ACA, SCR, rebalancing or acceleration.
No result authorizes Stage 4, Stage 5, a long Picard trajectory or an automatic precision experiment.
No mismatch may be repaired with a tolerance, fit, relaxation, clipping, flux floor or empirical coefficient.

next_step_by_class.INVALID: repair only the evidence or run implementation and repeat the same bounded census
next_step_by_class.VALID-GMRES-UPDATE-ACTIVE: separately freeze, but do not automatically run, a GMRES correction-accumulation precision A/B
next_step_by_class.VALID-GMRES-UPDATE-INACTIVE: abandon the inactive GMRES update experiment and separately freeze an always-executed MCGFCS source-arithmetic precision A/B
